name: Alameda County Fair Seasonal Jobs
what_you_do: You work at the county fair. Jobs include tickets at the gate, exhibits, the animal barns, parking, the tram and event work.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older. If you are 17 or younger, you need a work permit from your school unless you have already graduated. Some jobs, such as racing, cash handling, childcare, amphitheater usher, entertainment transport and parking seller, need you to be 18 or older.
pay_detail: $17.00 to $20.00 per hour, depending on the job, as listed on the program page.
deadline_text: The program page says 2027 information is coming soon. Hiring dates and the fair dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Fill out the job form online. Or print the paper form and send it in.
notes: Pay examples from the program page: Admissions Ambassador $18.00, Exhibits Attendant $17.00, Event Operations Tech $20.00. The job email is jobs@alamedacountyfair.com. The phone is 925-426-7600. The fair office is at 4501 Pleasanton Ave. The program page does not say how many hours a week you will work.
